purpose: Maps recovered vision sources to current scope. Historical text is input for reconciliation, not live authority.

acceptanceLedger.rationale: Maps all active feature groups and individual interface requirements to explicit, currently missing acceptance evidence without claiming completion.

entries.rationale: The personal, art-led world is the active consumer direction.
Family administration, presence, and child boundaries remain household-core work.
Older provider and Books assumptions are superseded by the current source policy and feature register.
Appliance capability is active only when it is measured and backed by release evidence.
Local intelligence is optional, measured, and bounded; historical performance claims do not establish release truth.
Recovered technical screens remain behind owner/support access until replaced or retired with evidence.
Promotion requires a separately approved rights, service, and safety plan.
Promotion requires authenticated enrollment, consent, signing, and threat review.
